role: Declares item use: ItemInWorldManager.tryUseItem and activateBlockOrUseItem's item half over a small player and stack record, the look-ray block query, and the live Item.itemRand stream hookup; its header comment lists which Java body maps to which C function and what is deliberately left out.

structs.name: iu_player
structs.java: EntityPlayer fields read by item use: posX/Y/Z, yOffset, rotationYaw/Pitch, capabilities.allowEdit, capabilities.isCreativeMode

structs.name: iu_stack
structs.java: ItemStack (item id, stackSize, itemDamage; no tag)

notes: Flat structs, no pointers. Hazards are recorded on itemuse.c.
